newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Royal Mail red pillar boxes up for sale in Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: Royal Mail red pillar boxes up for sale in Hong Kong.

text.p: Searching for an unusual present or a slice of the territory's legacy ahead of its return to China in July? What about a Royal Mail "pillar box"?
The Hong Kong government invited bids on Thursday for 27 old mail boxes, a fast disappearing symbol of British colonial rule.
The bright red cast iron boxes come replete with the British crown insignia and royal monogram. The tender closes on June 27.
Hong Kong is purging icons of British colonial rule as it zeroes in on the sovereignty change at midnight on June 30.
Stamps and new coins no longer show the Queen's head and many clubs have dropped their "Royal" prefixes.
Insignia and royal crests are being removed from mail boxes to be kept. After the handover post boxes will be painted green and decorated with a new bird logo in place of the crown.
